notes.title: Update notes for patch 0.5.1.2
notes.content:
- The new game button now has to be held to confirm a new save if an existing one already exists; this prevents players from accidentally deleting their save.
- You can now hold the buy button on upgrades, and the purchase speed gets faster the longer you hold down.
- Food reserve positions have been slightly adjusted and are now consistent in each room; additionally, the food percentage appears below them.
- Food reserves now respawn once getting back into the game, without needing the player to go manually into each livestock room.
- Fixed an issue with the input indicators not appearing on Vixen and Juno.
- Fixed Charlie's input indicators, which now properly show the S input on the right.
- Fixed a couple of dialogues showing the wrong character talking.
- Fixed an issue with consumable items going into negatives.
- Fixed an issue with the strawberry prompt button showing the wrong button.
- Fixed an issue with the livestock upgrade not activating

notes.title: Update notes for patch 0.5.1.1

notes.title: Welcome to Sloppy Fields!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you all for your patience!
Sloppy Fields is finally available on Steam in Early Access.[/h3][p]I'm happy to finally announce that Sloppy Fields is finally here.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467839/6aeb8435e8a722d7e54fb63418831fae439d3459.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]
As an early access title, the game requires balancing and some tweaking on game systems, but you can expect the first hours to go out smoothly and have a nice experience in the fields.[/p][p]A lot of content has already been planned, and you can expect the first months to focus mainly on polishing what's already in the game ([b]and more lewd content as well[/b]).[/p][p][/p][h3]Here's the basic roadmap for Sloppy Fields' EA timeline[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467839/02bb9a772468e938c8f0416a6326b6bbb8249127.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Your Feedback is crucial, [/b]so make sure to join our community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/rbwUxjzbjj"]Discord [/url]to share your thoughts, vote on community polls, and be updated on the game's progress in real time!
[/p][p]A big thank you to everyone who will assist me in making this game the best it can be!
Happy Farming![/p]

notes.title: Development update - Launch date and roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
It's been a while, and I wanted to update you on how the development of Sloppy Fields is going and make a couple of announcements.
[b]First and foremost, if everything goes well, the game will be launched for sale in early access this upcoming June.[/b]
Steam will also get a demo with a couple of new things for the Steam Fest, in case you want to try it, make sure to check it out once Nextfest drops!

[h3]At launch, the game will have the following features[/h3]
- 5 Races of animals to breed and sell
- 5 Matrons with 2 cutscenes each
- Breeding and farming mechanics
- A massage minigame to increase your matrons' affection
- An affection system: take care of your matrons to increase your farm's efficiency  
- More Additional story cgs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467839/72ba13c7e6ef0d136795754ae9a27ef6d57377dc.gif[/img]

[h3]"what's the plan after that?"[/h3]
Currently, the game is at about 50% completion, with major game systems being at about 70%, art at 35% and story at 50%. Since the programming part has been almost completed, I will be able to focus the majority of my efforts for the remaining development cycle on the remaining art and story content.

Every major update after the launch, will introduce 1 one new matron, [b]with at least 2 new cutscenes. [/b][b]Addional lewd content will also be added in the following forms[/b] 
- A pixel photography album to fill up with cgs for every girl
- Nightime pixel cutscenes that trigger when you "ignore" your girls too much


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467839/02bb9a772468e938c8f0416a6326b6bbb8249127.png[/img]



Anyway, I will make sure to do more in the upcoming months to give everyone more info on how the development is going, I hope you guys will like what the game currently offers, also, if you want to discuss about the game, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rbwUxjzbjj]discord![/url]

Take care y'all!
PixelPanzone
